_comment: Differences between dev and production that are accepted, each with its reason. Keep this list short: anything here is a difference a release will not be warned about. check.mjs reports entries that no longer match anything so they can be removed.

differences.name: supabase_admin:public:*
differences.reason: Dev has Supabase-platform default privileges for the supabase_admin role in public; production has none. They only affect objects Supabase itself creates as supabase_admin (our migrations run as postgres), and the postgres role cannot change another role's defaults.

differences.name: hypopg
differences.reason: Installed on production by the Supabase dashboard's index advisor (with index_advisor). Diagnostic tooling only; no application object depends on it.

differences.name: index_advisor
differences.reason: Installed on production by the Supabase dashboard's index advisor (with hypopg). Diagnostic tooling only; no application object depends on it.
